approach: Add one short paragraph (~80 tokens) to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and a bullet under "### Added" (or "### Changed" if present) in [Unreleased] of CHANGELOG.md. No other files.

decisions.choice: Put the instruction only in the change capability prompt.

rejected.why: Out of scope; would blow the study budget.

files.purpose: Record the change with the 2026-10-18 timeout cause.

steps: Append the instruction paragraph to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, under ~100 tokens, covering criteria 1 and 2.
Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet under [Unreleased] naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes).
Run the budgets test and cargo test -p athena-context; adjust wording if over budget.

risks.mitigation: Keep it under ~100 tokens; run the budgets test.

risks.risk: A snapshot test embeds the prompt.
risks.mitigation: Run cargo test -p athena-context before finishing; report if a snapshot breaks.

demonstrations.observes: Text says fmt, clippy and test results under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' are recorded for this candidate; cite them, do not rerun the full cargo test suite; 'cargo test passes' is met by citing the record.
Text says a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass and only that check may be run; new behavior is exercised with `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`.
An entry in [Unreleased] naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes) as the reason.
Passes; change set tokens printed at or under 1300 (was 1147).
demonstrations.fails_without: The budget test would fail if the added text pushed the change set over 1300 tokens.

demonstrations.observes: All tests pass, including brief snapshot tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: A snapshot test would fail if a brief embedding the change prompt changed unexpectedly.

open_questions: Whether any athena-context snapshot embeds the change verifier prompt text; if so the snapshot would need updating, which criterion 4 forbids. Producer should run the tests and report.
